welcome.title: Not just a place to stay. An experience to remember.
body: Villa Devonté was created for people who believe hospitality should feel personal. Tucked away in the quiet streets of Calli Phase 1, our villa blends warm Nigerian generosity with quietly confident luxury.

Come for a night, stay for a weekend, or simply arrive for dinner and a cocktail by the water. Every corner of the property — from the sunlit suites to the softly lit lounge — is designed to slow you down.

experiences.title: Rooms & Suites
experiences.text: Six individually styled rooms with premium linens, rain showers and garden views.

experiences.title: Restaurant
experiences.text: Local Nigerian classics and continental plates, served from morning until late.

experiences.title: The Lounge
experiences.text: Low light, signature cocktails, live sets and a soundtrack that runs till 2AM.

experiences.title: Hot Tub
experiences.text: A private, heated outdoor soak under the Calabar sky. Bookable by the hour.

about.title: A villa built on warmth, detail and quiet luxury.
story: Villa Devonté began with a simple idea: that a stay should feel like being welcomed into someone's home — only with better linen, better food and a much better bar.

What started as a private family residence in Calli Phase 1 has grown into a full hospitality destination. The rooms remain intimate. The kitchen still cooks to order. The lounge still fills with friends who arrived as strangers.
We are a small team. We remember your name, your table and how you take your coffee. That is not a policy — it is simply how we were raised.

philosophy.title: Warmth First
philosophy.text: Genuine Nigerian hospitality — unhurried, attentive and never performative.

philosophy.title: Detail Obsessed
philosophy.text: From the thread count to the playlist, everything at Villa Devonté is chosen on purpose.

philosophy.title: Effortless Access
philosophy.text: No accounts, no forms to fight. One WhatsApp message and your table, room or ticket is arranged.

rooms.name: The Devonté Suite
rooms.short: Our signature suite — king bed, private terrace and a freestanding tub.
rooms.description: The Devonté Suite is the largest room in the villa and the one guests return for. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto a private terrace overlooking the garden and pool. Inside, a king bed dressed in Egyptian cotton sits beside a freestanding soaking tub and a rain shower built for two. It is quiet, warm and deliberately unhurried.

rooms.name: Garden Villa Room
rooms.short: Ground-floor room opening directly onto the villa gardens.
rooms.description: Set on the ground floor with sliding doors that open straight onto the lawn, the Garden Villa Room is our most peaceful stay. Wake up to birdsong, take your coffee on the patio, and let the garden be your living room.

rooms.name: Terrace King
rooms.short: Upper-floor king room with a wide private balcony.
rooms.description: A bright upper-floor room with a generous private balcony that catches the evening breeze. Ideal for guests who like to sit outside with a glass of wine before dinner downstairs.

rooms.name: Deluxe Queen
rooms.short: Comfortable queen room — our best value stay.
rooms.description: Everything you need and nothing you don't. The Deluxe Queen is a calm, well-appointed room with a plush queen bed, a proper rain shower and blackout curtains for long lie-ins.

rooms.name: Executive Twin
rooms.short: Two full beds — perfect for friends or colleagues travelling together.
rooms.description: A spacious twin room with two full beds, a work desk and plenty of storage. Popular with friends on a getaway and colleagues on a work trip.

rooms.name: The Loft
rooms.short: A double-height loft with a mezzanine lounge and skylight.
rooms.description: Our most characterful room. The Loft opens into a double-height space with a mezzanine lounge, a skylight over the bed and a reading nook that guests tend to fight over.

restaurant.title: Nigerian soul. Continental polish. One kitchen.
restaurant.intro: Our kitchen cooks to order — nothing sits under a lamp. Expect the smoky jollof you grew up with, alongside steaks, pastas and seafood plated with a lighter hand.
body: Breakfast runs from 8AM with fresh pastries, seasonal fruit and proper coffee. Lunch is relaxed and generous. Dinner is where the room slows down: candles on every table, the grill working hard and a wine list built to be drunk, not admired.
The restaurant is open to villa guests and to the public. Reservations are recommended for weekends and can be made in seconds on WhatsApp.

highlights.title: Cooked To Order
highlights.text: Every plate is fired when you order it — no buffets, no heat lamps.

highlights.title: Local & Continental
highlights.text: Two kitchens in one: Nigerian classics and European comfort food.

highlights.title: Open Daily
highlights.text: 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, seven days a week. Walk-ins welcome.

lounge.title: Low light. Good sound. Better company.
lounge.intro: Villa Devonté's lounge is where the villa changes character after dark. Velvet seating, a backlit bar and a resident DJ programme that runs Thursday through Sunday.
body: The cocktail list leans on tropical fruit, dark spirits and house-made syrups. If you'd rather not choose, tell the bar what you usually drink and they will build something around it.
Tables are limited and weekends fill quickly. Reserve on WhatsApp and we'll hold your spot — no deposit required for standard tables.
experiences: Live sax & DJ sets — Thursday to Sunday

hotTub.title: A private heated soak, under the Calabar sky.
hotTub.intro: Our outdoor hot tub is heated to 38°C and screened for privacy. It is bookable by the hour — for couples, small groups or a quiet solo reset.
body: Each session includes fresh towels, robes, a fruit platter and still water. Add a bottle of wine or a cocktail pitcher and we'll have it waiting on the deck when you arrive.
Sessions are limited to 6 guests and must be booked in advance. The tub is drained and sanitised between every booking.

pricing.title: Day Session
pricing.text: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Includes towels, robes and water.

pricing.title: Evening Session
pricing.text: 5:00 PM – 10:00 PM. Candlelit deck and ambient sound.

pricing.title: Private Buyout
pricing.text: Exclusive use of the deck, tub and bar service.

rules: Bookings are confirmed on WhatsApp and held for 15 minutes past the start time.
Maximum 6 guests per standard session; 10 for private buyouts.
Shower before entering the tub. Swimwear required.
No glass near the tub — we provide unbreakable glassware.
Children under 12 must be supervised at all times.
Please disclose any medical conditions or pregnancy before booking.
Sessions may be rescheduled for weather at no cost.
